answer: Before a payout, every claim enters a lottery: one in ten is drawn for a deep audit by two independent auditors, who check the full work trail within two days. A clean audit clears the claim; a duplicate forfeits all pending claims and bars it for thirty days. Honest claims usually clear at once and an audit costs only a short wait, while a dune of fake claims would see a tenth audited and each caught fake lose everything — a gap near 1,000 to 1. When one operator filed fifty copies tied by the same copper thread, the audit anchored on the first claim, traced the rest, and voided them all.
